chapter: Studio recordings of the late twenties and thirties
title: Working with Artie Shaw
summary: He made many records with Shaw, who demanded everything be played to his beat.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: No, okay. Do you remember making some records with Artie Shaw?
I made a lot of them with him.
You did? How was working with him?
Was he difficult, was he difficult to work with?
No, he had his beat, you know. And everything was to his beat.
It had to be to his beat.
And you had no trouble giving him his beat I'm sure.
